Direct shear test on SS soil (White Silica Sand (Wedron 4040-narrowly graded)), loose; apparatus: direct shear (University of Notre Dame). Recorded: peak shear strength vs normal stress with least-squares line (Univac 1107, CAL-COMP plot).

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple"}
The numbers below were digitized from the published figure by two readings made separately; they agree within the stated reading bounds at 17 of the 21 points, and 1 is still under review. Student reviewers have looked at 13 of the 21 points on the scan; two reviewers confirmed 6 of them (see the provenance page). The test setup is incomplete: relative density Dr, specimen height, normal stress, held constant, displacement rate are not reported.
:::

## Data

![shear strength (peak shear stress) against normal stress, SI units. Error bars are reading bounds (half-widths from the digitization), not standard deviations. Filled markers were agreed by both readings, hollow ones were not.](../img/plots/b68-ds-fc-13.png){.lightbox}

Peak shear strength (peak shear stress) 125.8 kPa at 221.7 kPa normal stress; 125.9 kPa at 222.2 kPa, the end of the record.

Download: [observations.csv](../files/data/experiments/b68-ds-fc-13/observations.csv) (21 points: 7 plotted symbols, 11 samples of the drawn curve; columns `x_si`, `y_si` with bounds `x_bound_si`, `y_bound_si`; panel 1: shear strength (peak shear stress) in Pa against normal stress in Pa; the printed-unit values, the pixel position on the scan and the review status of each point are kept in further columns) and [series.json](../files/data/experiments/b68-ds-fc-13/series.json) (units, conversion factors, how the points were read).

Reading bounds on this figure (how far our reading of the printed figure may be off, not the uncertainty of the test): typical bound 1.0 kPa in normal stress, 1.0 kPa in shear strength (0.8 percent of the peak). Both independent readings agree within these bounds at 17 of the 21 points; 1 is still under review (hollow in the plot) and 3 were settled against the scan. [Check the digitized points against the scan](../figures/index.qmd#check-fc-13).
